title: Specialistläkare - möten online
description:
Vill du ha ett flexibelt arbete där du får vara med och utveckla den digitala vården? Vi på Medicheck söker nu specialistläkare inom flera olika områden!

Som specialistläkare på Medicheck möts du och patienten genom videomöten i vår digitala plattform där du får möjligheten att arbeta med just ditt specialistområde. Hos oss kommer du arbeta med sjukvårdsrådgivning, bedömning och behandling av patienter. Du väljer själv hur mycket du vill arbeta och det går utmärkt att kombinera tjänsten med andra uppdrag .
Just nu har vi störst behov inom följande områden:

• Neurologi

• Gastroenterologi

• Endokrinologi

• Gynekologi

• Urologi

• Dermatologi

• Psykiatri

• Reumatologi

Kom ihåg att du alltid är varmt välkommen att ansöka oavsett vilken specialitet du har.
Vi letar efter dig som...

• Är legitimerad specialistläkare

• Är lyhörd och sätter patienten i fokus

• Vill utveckla den digitala vården

• Har god datorvana

Vi erbjuder dig...

• Möjligheten att arbeta med just ditt specialistområde

• Smidiga digitala möten med patienter utan föregående remisskrav

• Flexibla arbetstider och arbetssätt - du bestämmer själv när du vill arbeta

• Trygga och säkra möten - du och patienten loggar in med BankID

• Support för dig via mail, telefon och chatt

• En tjänst som uppfyller kraven för medicinsk rådgivning över internet med allt du behöver, som enkel journalföring, förskrivning av recept, automatisk bokföring och fakturering

Övrig information
Start: Flexibelt , omgående eller enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetets omfattning: Flexibla arbetstider och arbetssätt - du bestämmer själv hur mycket och när du vill arbeta. Fördelaktigt är om du kan arbeta under vardagar.
Anställningsform: Konsult, du fakturerar genom ditt egna bolag.
Dina personuppgifter hanteras enligt lagen om behandling av personuppgifter (PUL/GDPR) och kommer endast att användas för ändamål relaterade till tjänsten.
Om oss
Medicheck hjälper patienter över hela landet och vår affärsidé är att det ska vara enkelt för en patient att komma i kontakt med en specialist som kan utreda, följa upp och vid behov hitta nya behandlingar för patientens individuella behov. Detta sker digitalt i största mån, men även fysiskt vid behov.
Vi har funnits sedan 2016 och består av ett nätverk med ca 150 specialistläkare, dietister och psykologer. Det finns ett centralt team om cirka 7 personer som består av ledning, medicinskt ansvar, HR, support, ekonomi, teknik och marknad.
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Senior/ Lead Security Researcher
description:
Summary of Role
V-Key is one of the world’s leading deep-tech companies in mobile cyber-security. Our patented technology V-OS has been deployed by top banks, mobile payment providers, and governments to secure software solutions and protect more than 500 million users globally.
We are rapidly expanding into new markets and new customer segments. Apart from securing digital transactions for everyone, we are also enabling new generation technology by providing the cyber-security infrastructure for banking, government and smart homes, among many others.
At V-Key, we are building towards a future where technology users can enjoy unprecedented security and convenience.
We are looking for a (Senior or Lead) Security Researcher, as part of the Product Security Team. Your primary focus will be to work with the team on cutting-edge Research and Development (R&D) of threats on mobile phones to develop innovative products and solutions to defend against such threats.
Duties and Responsibilities

• Research into threats (such as root/jailbreak and hiding thereof, app tampering, runtime tampering, etc.) in mobile phone operating systems and applications on Android / iOS / Harmony OS Next.

• Work with the team to develop protection mechanisms through reverse engineering, vulnerability research, exploitation and mitigation techniques and mobile/embedded development.

• Work with the team to perform penetration test on V-Key’s products and applications.

• Work with the team to script attacks and defences for mobile devices in general and for mobile applications.

• Develop customer-facing security attack and defense demonstrations.

• Work with the team on security solutions architectures involving not just the mobile device, but also other networked components, leveraging authentication protocols (OAuth2, FIDO2, etc.), and understanding and assessing cryptographic protocols and algorithms as needed.

Requirements

• Should have 5+years of experience into this relevant field.

• Good understanding of operating system internals (one or more of Android, iOS, Harmony OS Next, Linux, etc.) and app development (especially mobile).

• Familiar with rooting/jailbreaking, runtime tampering, app tampering, and tools that can be used to hide them.

• Familiar with attack and reverse engineering tools such as Frida, Theos, Ghidra, and IDA Pro.

• Familiar with web VAPT tools like Burp Suite.

• Familiar with how various tools/methodologies work, allowing innovation and creative solutions, not just comfortable using the tools as is.

• Good understanding of threat modelling, including familiarity with at least one threat modelling framework.

• A strong self-starter and able to work with minimal supervision, while still receptive to suggestions and ways to improve.

• Project ownership on selected projects.

• Guidance/mentorship of junior security researchers.

• Detail oriented with a strong focus on quality.

• Systematic and methodical in research and testing, while being creative and innovative.

• Ability to work in a dynamic, fast moving and growing environment.

• Positive work attitude, proactive and highly driven.

• Critical thinker and problem-solving skills.

• Team player with great interpersonal and communication skills.

Nice to have

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Math (especially related to cryptography) or related field.

• Certifications related to information security, ethical hacking, security solution design.

• Have built tools/scripts to help with various security research tasks.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

As a Data Scientist for Growth at Legora, you'll build the data foundations that help our go-to-market teams make better decisions. You'll work end-to-end: connecting data from business systems, building reliable pipelines and dbt models, defining shared metrics, and answering questions about how we grow.

Your background may be in analytics engineering, data science or data engineering. You enjoy building data models that others can trust and reuse, and working closely with business teams to put that data to use.

You'll be based in our New York office, sitting with the Growth data team. Our go-to-market data is spread across a CRM, marketing automation and messaging platforms, sales engagement and call tools, support tooling, and our own product. Making those systems agree with each other, and with what customers actually do in Legora, is the heart of this job.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

We're a small, centralised team supporting the whole company. This seat is for Growth. Working closely with RevOps and the GTM teams, you'll help answer questions like:

- Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution and CAC, campaign measurement, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.

- Sales & RevOps: what drives pipeline, sales performance and pilot-to-customer conversion.

- Customer Success: account health, expansion and churn signals, and renewals in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

- Lifecycle: getting modelled data back into the CRM and messaging tools, so teams act on it where they already work.

You'll partner directly with leaders across Marketing, Sales, RevOps and Customer Success who are data-fluent and eager to act on the wealth of data across our business. Your role is to bring structure to that data, uncover insights together, and build the tools and foundations that let them explore questions for themselves, shaping how we sell, where we spend, how we price, and which customers we invest in.

title: UX Copywriter

About Bask Health

Bask Health is building the infrastructure that powers modern telehealth businesses.
Our platform enables healthcare companies to launch, operate, and scale digital care experiences, from patient onboarding and clinical workflows to prescriptions, payments, subscriptions, fulfillment, and ongoing care.
We're looking for a UX Copywriter to make complex healthcare and software experiences feel clear, human, and easy to navigate.
This isn't a marketing copywriting role.
You'll work directly inside the product alongside Design, Product, and Engineering, shaping how Bask communicates with users at every step of their experience.
About the Role
As a UX Copywriter at Bask, you'll own the words that help people understand what's happening, what they need to do, and what happens next.
You'll work across both sides of our platform: the businesses and healthcare teams operating on Bask, and the patients interacting with the experiences those businesses create.
That means writing everything from navigation, buttons, forms, empty states, errors, and onboarding flows to questionnaires, treatment experiences, transactional communications, and AI-powered interactions.
But this role isn't simply about making copy sound better.
You'll work with designers to solve product problems through language, challenge unnecessary complexity, identify when a UX problem can't be fixed with copy alone, and help establish the systems that allow Bask to communicate consistently at scale.
We value writers who are concise, highly collaborative, comfortable with complex products, and opinionated about clarity.

• Write for complex operational experiences used by healthcare businesses, providers, and internal teams without exposing unnecessary technical complexity to users..

• Help users understand what is happening, what action they need to take, and what they can expect next-especially during high-friction or high-stakes moments..

• Work with designers to improve information architecture, hierarchy, naming, navigation, and interaction patterns through language..

• Identify when unclear copy is actually a symptom of a larger product or design problem and work with the team to solve the underlying issue..

• Develop terminology and naming systems for new features, concepts, statuses, actions, and workflows..

• Create and maintain content guidelines that establish consistent voice, tone, terminology, grammar, and writing patterns across Bask..

• Build reusable content patterns for common product situations such as errors, confirmations, destructive actions, permissions, empty states, and system feedback..

• Collaborate with Product Research to understand how users interpret terminology, instructions, and product concepts..

• Test and iterate on product language using research, product data, experimentation, and user feedback..

• Partner with Engineering to ensure content works across different states, edge cases, responsive layouts, and dynamic experiences..

• Help define how Bask communicates through AI-powered experiences, including prompts, generated content, explanations, recommendations, confirmations, and conversational interfaces..

• Use AI tools to accelerate exploration, iteration, audits, and content operations while maintaining strong human judgment over clarity, accuracy, context, and tone..

• Contribute to scalable content systems that allow teams to create consistent experiences without requiring a writer to manually review every

Co-developed with customers, sensmore is backed by Point Nine Capital, leading industry investors, the State of Brandenburg, and the European Union.

Robot Operation & Safety Supervision:
Operate and supervise our autonomous machines during training and testing sessions, mainly remotely from the office and occasionally on site. Act as the safety supervisor, monitoring every run closely and stepping in when something doesn’t look right.

Readiness Checks & Documentation:
Complete pre-operation checklists to confirm each machine is safe and ready to run. Keep clear, accurate records of sessions, incidents and anomalies.

Technical Troubleshooting:
Monitor systems during operation, carry out first-line checks and collect the data our engineers need. Escalate issues with concise, well-structured reports.

Testing Support:
Help run test sessions, log results and feed your observations back to the engineering team to improve machine performance and test procedures.

What You Bring

- A valid driving licence, held for at least 2 years, and confidence behind the wheel (mandatory)

- A responsible, safety-conscious approach to every task

- Diligent, thorough and well organised, with a strong troubleshooting mindset

- Technical understanding: you’re a PC power user

- Flexibility on shift patterns, including evenings, fitting around your studies

Nice to have

- Solid technical understanding: comfortable working in the terminal / Linux, ideally with experience of observability tools (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus)

- Experience with heavy machinery or construction equipment

- A deeper understanding of testing processes

- Willingness to work night shifts

WHAT WE OFFER:

- Build physical AI for the world's largest off-highway machinery - making them intelligent, safe, and ready for every tough task

- Join the pioneer in intelligent robotics backed by Point Nine & other Tier 1 investors

- Combine cutting-edge robotics research in end-to-end learning & Vision Language Action Model with real-world heavy mobile equipment

- Tailor your own career path, whether you like to become technical specialist or technical team lead

- Experience a great team culture, beverages, and an amazing office environment

BENEFITS:

- Attractive compensation package and stock options.

- Beverages on-site and regular social events.

- Engage with top-tier researchers, engineers, and thought leaders.

- Influence the future of robotic technologies and tackle significant technological challenges.

- Assistance with relocation to Berlin.

ABOUT US:

Heavy machinery, light years ahead.

sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training.

We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today.

We are proudly backed by Point Nine and other Tier 1 investors.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced accountant to own Equity Accounting and Reporting at Anthropic, based in San Francisco. You will be the one owner of equity accounting numbers across US GAAP, IFRS and local GAAP in every jurisdiction where we have employees holding equity: expense booking by entity, intercompany recharge booking, current and deferred tax on equity, and the equity footnote and local statutory disclosures, prepared once and reused. You will own equity reporting data from Shareworks, our equity administration platform, through to the ledgers, while staying hands-on: preparing and reviewing close materials, owning your own accounts, and serving as the first escalation point for the judgment calls in your domain.

Share-based compensation (SBC) is one of the most cross-functional areas of our reporting. Grants, vesting, exercises and the events that follow each carry requirements for US GAAP, IFRS and local GAAP expense, pushdown and recharge postings, tax provisioning, payroll withholding, transfer pricing and statutory disclosure, and those needs are met across Equity Administration, Equity Reporting, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Transfer Pricing and Global Payroll from a single set of award-level records. This is a build role: you will take the open workstreams from manual to automated, work with Finance Systems and Shareworks to build the reports each stage needs, finalize the policies and agreements that sit behind recharges, and bring the end-to-end process to a scalable, efficient and fully compliant close. We are looking for someone who has owned equity accounting in a growing global organization before and wants to do it again at one of the most important companies in the world.

Key responsibilities

Close ownership

•
Own the equity portfolio through month-end and quarter-end close: US GAAP, IFRS and local GAAP equity expense, pushed down and booked by entity, including reconciliations, journal entries and variance commentary

•
Own intercompany recharge booking: invoicing, settlement, Treasury communication and the foreign exchange (FX) that follows

•
Own current and deferred tax on equity by entity and in local currency, including the IFRS deferred tax mark to the share price and windfalls or shortfalls through the tax provision

•
Ensure every close deliverable is audit-ready, with clear documentation of positions and supporting evidence

Technical accounting and policy

•
Write, own and maintain the accounting policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for equity across US GAAP, IFRS and local GAAP: grant-date fair value and expense schedules, recharge basis by entity, mobility apportionment, and the treatment of cancellations, modifications and one-off events

•
Partner closely with Tax to close every open policy position and execute the recharge agreements that depend on them

•
Research the tax and accounting rules for each new jurisdiction entered and categorize it under our framework before the first grant lands there

•
Own the equity footnote and local statutory disclosures for all entities, including the award rollforward for each period with internal transfers, and the external audit responses that support them

Controls

•
Design and operate Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls across equity expense, recharges and deferred tax; review control evidence and own timely remediation of any gaps

•
Establish completeness and cut-off controls so that the same award, the same entity, the same event dates and the same FX rate flow from Shareworks to every ledger, report and return

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

You will be embedded with the Life Sciences pod and work in close partnership with ML Science, Product Management, Design, Legal/Privacy, and our external research and pharma partners.

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Romania. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.
You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.
What you will work on
Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.
What you bring
Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.
Useful but not essential:
Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

title: Senior NetSuite Systems Administrator

We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

- Build the financial infrastructure from the ground up (NetSuite, Zip, Pigment, Visual Lease, Shareworks, Travel and Expense, and Treasury management).

- Train and support finance users as the first point of contact for NetSuite, and document every configuration and script clearly enough that others can pick it up.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like - and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

We're defining what AI-first product development looks like in practice: the UI/UX, the capabilities, the data models, and the systems underneath them. It's a wide open problem space, and you'll be one of the people deciding which problems matter most and how we solve them.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.

When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human . This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.

The work combines research and production engineering:

•
The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Develop contact center solution designs and present recommendations to customer stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into business outcomes

Develop and maintain contact flow documentation, runbooks, and operational handoff materials

Partner with Avahi ’s full-stack developers to build custom CCP interfaces, agent desktop applications, and backend integrations using Lambda, DynamoDB, and other AWS services

•

Coordinate with data scientists and AI/ML engineers on conversational AI use cases including Amazon Lex bot design and natural language IVR flows

•

Work with cloud architects on infrastructure decisions including networking, security, and IAM configurations for Connect deployments

•

Contribute to the development of reusable patterns, templates, and accelerators for future Connect engagements

Telephone & Contact Center Expertise

•

Advise customers on number porting, DID management, toll-free provisioning, and carrier integration strategies

•

Translate legacy contact center configurations (Avaya, Cisco, Genesys, Five9, etc.) into Amazon Connect architectures

•

Guide customers through change management considerations when migrating from on-premise or hosted contact center platforms to cloud

Required Qualifications

•

3+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (contact flows, queues, routing profiles, agent configuration)

•

Demonstrated experience running customer-facing workshops, requirements gathering sessions, and solution design presentations

•

Solid understanding of traditional telephony concepts: SIP/PSTN, IVR design, ACD routing, CTI, call recording, workforce management fundamentals

Experience integrating Amazon Connect with at least one major CRM platform, particularly Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho

title: Knowledge Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

Great support depends on knowledge that is accurate, easy to find and always up to date. That's hard to maintain by hand in a product that changes every week, so we're looking for someone who builds automation to do it. As a Knowledge Manager in Quality & Training, you'll join a team working on exactly this, and build the automations that keep our internal knowledge base current. You'll also help keep our Help Center sharp by working closely with Support, listening to the people who use it and following what the data tells you.

Your first project is a full review and rewrite of the internal knowledge base, with a consistent structure and a clear thread running through it. If you do this well, issues get resolved faster, fewer questions repeat, and more customers find answers on their own. This is a role for someone with solid experience who is curious and keen to grow: you'll learn from a team that is shaping how Legora shares knowledge, with room to take on more as you go. This role is based in Stockholm.

What you'll do

- Build automations that keep the internal knowledge base current, such as flagging articles for update when a product or code change affects them

- Deliver your work in close collaboration with your Quality & Training teammates, as well as Technical Operations, Product and Engineering

- Rewrite and restructure the internal knowledge base, starting with Technical Operations content, around one consistent structure

- Work closely with Support to collect feedback from agents, and use it to update and improve Help Center articles

- Pull data from our support tool to find where content falls short, and help decide what to write, fix or retire next

- Help look after the ongoing quality of our knowledge and shape the standard for what a good article looks like

- Share what you learn through training, guides and quick tips so teams get more out of the knowledge we have

title: Senior Applied AI Researcher

Overview:

Guidepoint is hiring a Senior Applied AI Researcher for its new Applied AI/ML team in Toronto. You'll build and optimize NLP, LLM and machine learning systems in production, and run the experiments that decide which models and techniques we build on.

You'll work on hard, open problems with real users and a large proprietary knowledge base and take ideas from first experiment to production. This is applied research: we don't train foundation models. We pick the right model and technique for each problem, prove it with evals, and make it faster and cheaper where it counts.

Guidepoint's mission is to make individuals, businesses and the world smarter through personalized knowledge-sharing. Our Toronto Technology Hub is home to Guidepoint's Data, AI and ML teams.

This is a hybrid role based in our Toronto office.

What You'll Do:

• Build, deploy and optimize LLM and NLP systems in production, from RAG and agents to classification and extraction, for quality, latency and cost

• Turn loosely defined problems into testable questions, run experiments and recommend what to build

• Build evaluation frameworks other teams can reuse, and assess new models as they're released

• Embed with product teams and own projects end to end, from framing to production

• Mentor junior engineers and share what you learn

What You Have:

• 5+ years of hands-on industry experience applying NLP, ML or AI to real products, with multiple production releases (3+ years with a Master's or PhD), and a degree in computer science, ML, statistics or a related field

• Hands-on fine-tuning (for example LoRA or QLoRA) and model optimization such as distillation or small language models, with sound judgement on when each beats better prompting or retrieval

• Strong evaluation skills: golden and synthetic datasets, metrics, and LLM-as-judge calibrated against human review

• Solid classical ML: gradient boosting, ranking, feature engineering and drift monitoring

• Strong Python (PyTorch, Hugging Face, scikit-learn) and production experience on a cloud platform; Azure, Databricks and MLflow are a plus

• Clear communication and comfort with ambiguity: you can shape a vague request into a question worth answering, and explain the result to any audience

• Experience in data-sensitive industries such as financial services or market research is a plus

What We Offer:  

The annual base salary range for this position is 170,000-200,000 CAD . Additionally, this position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on performance.

You will also be eligible for the following benefits:

• Paid Time Off

• Comprehensive benefits plan
